title: A booted wrapper does not outlive its test
requirement: a wrapper a test boots, and the agent under it, end when that test ends, whether the test passes, fails, times out or is killed, so no booted wrapper or fake agent is left running after a test run
observed_gap: On 2026-11-17 a mutation run killed tests at their timeout and five mutant-build wrappers stayed alive, each near 99 % of a core for 5 h 50 min, their fake agents with them; no test-side code ends a booted wrapper when its test is killed.
acceptance: After a test that booted a wrapper is killed mid-run, no wrapper or agent that test started is still running; a test that passes, fails or times out leaves none either.
